title: Loblolly & Logit · Six-Edition Reading Feature Re-Issue Audit
scope: All 30 readings across six editions, 2026-09-25 through 2026-10-30
policy: Evidence-led inclusion; no fixed quota; only distinct authored and qualified features. A third requires explicit rationale.
methodology: Retained all five authored primary exhibits per edition; recognized independent publication figures and diagrams as Economic Figures; added five source-bounded, explicitly non-estimated companion features where a second lens clarifies a separate economic question. Existing scholarship, links and archival dates are preserved.
limitations: No new primary-source verification or econometric estimation was performed. Editorial content and dates are preserved. Rendered layout audit covers all 30 readings across six editions; deployment verification is recorded separately from source preflight.

rules: Incidence Ledgers must display affected parties vertically, as successive rows, at all breakpoints.
Use existing content-driven space; avoid fixed-height blank panels and surplus gutters in reissued companions.
Preserve source text, figures, citations, issue identifiers, feature selection, and established typographic hierarchy.
layoutReissue.implementation: Two supplemental Incidence Ledgers now use party/effect row markup. Primary Ledgers retain their already-vertical structure. CSS implements content-led compact spacing for supplemental reading features.
layoutReissue.verification: Publisher layout guard passed: six editions, 30 readings, 19 notebook concepts, 53 source links; editorial composer idempotent.
layoutReissue.limitation: Production deployment and browser rendering not independently verified.
layoutReissue.cause: The Long View used a 4-column fallback for 3-stage lists, leaving 25% of the panel empty. The supplemental Ledger's CSS override was insufficient to ensure the rendered desktop presentation matched its intended vertical order.
fixes: Explicit authored 3/4 stage counts for seven Long Views (five three-stage, two four-stage).
One vertically stacked sequence of party/effect rows for the two supplemental Incidence Ledgers at all viewport widths, with late-loaded page-level safeguard.
Compact, content-sized companion containers and adaptive tablet/phone column behavior.
Preserved the 30 readings' original scholarship, existing special features, and publication dates.
